name: Song Of Moses
overview: The Song of Moses, as recorded in Exodus 15, celebrates God's triumphant deliverance of Israel from their enemies, highlighting His power in overthrowing the horse and rider in the sea. This song, echoed by Miriam and the people, acknowledges the Lord's glorious victory and faithfulness. Deuteronomy 32 and Psalms 90 further present Moses as a prophet and man of God, whose words call the heavens and earth to witness God's righteous deeds. Revelation 15 connects this ancient song to the ultimate victory in Christ, uniting the song of Moses with the song of the Lamb, affirming God's just and marvelous works throughout all generations.
